author: The Current
description:
Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis tell the story of how they got fired by Prince, and how it changed their lives
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Early in their career, Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis decided to produce some music for the S.O.S. Band — a decision that got them fired by Prince, but also launched their production career. “We were ‘fired,’ as
you say,” Terry Lewis says, “but I kind of rephrase it and say ‘freed’ by Prince. … And so we were off doing productions from then on.”

There’s a lot more detail to the story; check out the full account from Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis in their interview with The Current’s Jill Riley in the video above. 

Find even more from Jam and Lewis’ complete interview here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bMhV5nKNH2E

description:
Watch Jess Williamson's solo acoustic performance of "Goodbye to All That" recorded live at the Forum at MPR, home of The Current
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Singer-songwriter Jess Williamson’s new album, “A Mile South of Heaven,” released on Friday, Oct. 9. In the weeks leading up to the album’s release, Williamson visited The Current to record a session in the Forum at Minnesota Public Radio. Recorded in front of a live audience, Williamson performed solo acoustic versions of four songs off the new record, including this one, "Goodbye to All That."

Watch and listen to the full session here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bvn-hF0_gpk

Jess Williamson’s 2026 album, A Mile South of Heaven, is available on @NewWestRecords.

author: The Current
description:
Watch a performance of "James" by Minneapolis band Porch Light
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Minneapolis indie-rock band Porch Light were simply enjoying making music together, performing covers in a basement, when guitarist Kyle Siemon thought it might be fun to post a few videos on TikTok for the simple reason, “Everyone else is doing it.” The members of Porch Light thought it might be fun to see what might happen.

That was a little more than a year ago. Fast-forward to now, and Porch Light have more than half-a-million followers across social platforms, more than 25 million streams, and have sold out headlining shows in New York, Los Angeles and Chicago. Now signed to the label Mom+Pop Music, Porch Light released their debut album, "Hush," on September 18, 2026.

Named The Local Show’s artist of the month for October, Porch Light visited The Current studio to play four songs: their 2025 single, “Oxygen,” plus three songs from "Hush.
title: Porch Light — James (live in The Current studio)

author: The Current
description:
Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis reflect on the year 1986 in an interview with The Current's Jill Riley 
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis are original members of The Time — but they are best known as a songwriting duo and production team, having had more than 40 No. 1 hits on the Billboard charts. As producers and songwriters, they have been nominated for Producer of the Year at the Grammys 11 times, with one of those times being a big win. That big win came for work released in 1986, 40 years ago. 

When Jam and Lewis returned to their hometown this summer to perform a concert at the Minnesota State Fair, they visited Minnesota Public Radio for a conversation with The Current’s Jill Riley all about the year 1986. It was a pivotal year for the Minneapolis duo, as they racked up chart-topping hits for artists including Janet Jackson, The Human League, the S.O.S. Band and others.

Jam and Lewis shared stories and reflected
title: Jimmy Jam and Terry Lewis talk about 1986, a pivotal year in their career as hit-making producers
